btn_install.en: Install the app if you don't have it

hint_1.mt: Meta tiskennja l-QR fuq l-iskrin RayTok tat-telefown l-ieħor tasal hawn. Jekk l-app hija installata tinfetaħ mill-ewwel; jekk le, installaha bil-buttuna ta' fuq u erġa' skennja l-QR.
hint_1.en: Scanning the QR on the other phone's RayTok screen brings you here. If the app is installed it opens right away; if not, install it with the button above and scan the QR again.

hint_2.mt: Iż-żewġ telefowns iridu jkunu fuq l-istess Wi-Fi (jew il-hotspot ta' wieħed minnhom). M'hemmx bżonn internet.
hint_2.en: Both phones must be on the same Wi-Fi (or one phone's hotspot). No internet needed.

hint_3.mt: L-informazzjoni tal-konnessjoni fil-bar tal-indirizz hija l-indirizz lokali ta' dak it-telefown u kodiċi ta' verifika ta' darba. Ma tfisser xejn barra minn dak il-Wi-Fi u tieqaf taħdem hekk kif l-ospitant jagħlaq l-iskrin.
hint_3.en: The connection info in the address bar is that phone's local address and a one-time verification code. It means nothing unless you're on the same Wi-Fi, and it stops working as soon as the host closes the screen.

msg_no_info.mt: Din il-link m'għandhiex informazzjoni tal-konnessjoni. Jekk jogħġbok erġa' skennja l-QR fuq l-iskrin l-ieħor.
msg_no_info.en: This link has no connection info. Please scan the QR on the other screen again.

msg_android.mt: Jekk l-app hija installata tinfetaħ mill-ewwel. Jekk le, agħfas il-buttuna t'isfel.
msg_android.en: If the app is installed it will open right away. If not, tap the button below.

msg_ios.mt: Din il-link hija għall-app RayTok ta' Android. Għad m'hemmx app għall-iPhone.
msg_ios.en: This link is for the Android RayTok app. There is no iPhone app yet.
